preconditions.description: N must be between 1 and 4 inclusive.
K must be between 2 and 9 inclusive.
The number of possible strings of size N with K characters must be less than 4096.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i:i+N] in set(''.join(str(j) for j in range(K)) * (K**N)) for i in range(len(return_value) - N + 1))
postconditions.description: The returned string must contain all possible strings of size N as substrings.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == min(len(s) for s in generate_all_superstrings(N, K) if all(s[i:i+N] in set(''.join(str(j) for j in range(K)) * (K**N)) for i in range(len(s) - N + 1)))
postconditions.description: The length of the returned string must be the minimum length that contains all possible strings of size N as substrings.
